subject.title: WhatsApp pairing can stick at Logging in until gateway restart finalizes 515 recovery

question: Should the active WhatsApp phone-code PRs be required to eliminate the manual gateway restart during 515 finalization, or should this issue remain a separate recovery follow-up after phone-code login lands?
rationale: The remaining choice crosses WhatsApp plugin auth behavior, generic channel login API surface, and session-state upgrade safety, and current main cannot reproduce the phone-code path without accepting new product/API surface first.

options.title: Require restart-free proof in phone-code PR
options.body: Make the active phone-code implementation prove live WhatsApp pairing reaches linked/healthy/connected without a manual gateway restart, or document the intentional exception in that PR.

options.title: Split a dedicated 515 recovery fix
options.body: Let phone-code login land only for the entrypoint and credential cleanup, then keep this issue as the narrower tracker for in-process 515 finalization recovery.

options.title: Accept the restart workaround
options.body: Treat gateway restart during rare 515 phone-code finalization as supported operator recovery and update docs/runbooks instead of changing runtime behavior now.

recommendation.title: Require restart-free proof in phone-code PR
recommendation.body: Make the active phone-code implementation prove live WhatsApp pairing reaches linked/healthy/connected without a manual gateway restart, or document the intentional exception in that PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision affects public CLI/channel auth contract shape and WhatsApp plugin ownership boundaries, where recent history points to steipete as the strongest routing owner.
